title: New in Symfony 8.2: Forms That Read Your Types
content:
<html><head></head><body>Symfony forms are often backed by a DTO or another class with typed properties.
Those types say a lot about each field, but you have to repeat much of that information
when creating your forms. In Symfony 8.2, the Form component uses those types,
so forms…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
